# hpe_morpheus_network_router_bgp_neighbor (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_network_router_bgp_neighbor" "example" {
  router_id            = 42
  ip_address           = "10.0.0.1"
  description          = "Example BGP neighbor"
  remote_as            = "65001"
  weight               = 100
  keep_alive           = 60
  hold_down            = 180
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the BGP neighbor
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the network router

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allow_as_in` (Boolean) Allow AS-in
- `bfd_enabled` (Boolean) Enable BFD (Bidirectional Forwarding Detection)
- `bfd_interval` (Number) BFD interval in milliseconds
- `bfd_multiple` (Number) BFD multiplier
- `config` (Dynamic) Dynamic configuration
- `config_nsxt` (Attributes) Configuration for NSX-T Tier-0/Tier-1 router BGP neighbors (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_nsxt))
- `config_nsxv` (Attributes) Configuration for NSX-V Edge/Distributed router BGP neighbors (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_nsxv))
- `description` (String) Description of the BGP neighbor
- `forwarding_address` (String) Forwarding address (NSX-V distributed router)
- `hold_down` (Number) Hold-down timer in seconds
- `hop_limit` (Number) Maximum hop limit
- `keep_alive` (Number) Keep-alive interval in seconds
- `password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password (Write Only)
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Password version. Used to determine if password_wo has been updated.
- `protocol_address` (String) Protocol address (NSX-V distributed router)
- `remote_as` (String) Remote AS number
- `restart_mode` (String) Graceful restart mode (e.g. HELPER_ONLY, GRACEFUL_RESTART, DISABLE)
- `route_filtering_in` (String) Inbound route filter name
- `route_filtering_out` (String) Outbound route filter name
- `route_filtering_type` (String) Address family for route filtering (e.g. IPV4, IPV6)
- `weight` (Number) Route weight

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the BGP neighbor

<a id="nestedatt--config_nsxt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config_nsxt`

Optional:

- `source_addresses` (Set of String) Source IP addresses for the BGP session


<a id="nestedatt--config_nsxv"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config_nsxv`

Optional:

- `interface` (String) The interface name for the BGP session (distributed routers only)
- `router_id` (String) The router identifier (auto-populated for edge routers)

## Import

BGP neighbors can be imported using the `router_id.id` format, e.g.

```shell
# Import using router_id.id format
terraform import hpe_morpheus_network_router_bgp_neighbor.example 42.123
```
